The model version guardrail enforces temporal consistency by freezing the model version once initialized, preventing unintended regressions. The security gatekeeper ensures that only fully validated PRs can proceed past draft stage, forming a critical barrier against unauthorized or unsafe deployments. Failure modes occur when individual checks fail, causing cascading rejections in downstream systems.
